days.file: Alessandro Allori - St Peter Walking on the Water - WGA00184.jpg
days.title: Saint Peter Walking on the Water
days.alt: Christ reaches down and takes the hand of Peter, who is sinking into the dark water, while the boat waits behind them.
days.look: Look again at the two hands joined above the waves. Can you cry out to God, as Peter did, “Lord, save me”?
days.license: Artist died 1607; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Master of the Sherborne Almshouse Triptych - Christ healing the boy possessed by a demon, the healing of the blind Bartimaeus beyond.jpg
days.artist: Master of the Sherborne Almshouse Triptych
days.title: Christ Healing the Boy Possessed by a Demon
days.alt: Christ raises a hand in blessing while a young man in blue, held steady by an older man in a patterned coat, looks up with his hands together.
days.look: Look again at the hands raised toward Christ and the one who holds the young man steady. Can you say, as honestly as that father, what you believe and what you doubt?
days.license: Anonymous Netherlandish master active c. 1480–90; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Christ and the Rich Young Ruler
days.alt: Jesus turns toward a richly dressed young man, one hand open, while a poor beggar waits behind them.
days.look: Look again at Jesus’s open hand and the young man’s lowered gaze. What would it cost you to hand this one thing over to God?
days.license: Artist died 1911; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jan Steen, Dutch (active Leiden, Haarlem, and The Hague) - Moses Striking the Rock - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Moses Striking the Rock
days.alt: A young man in a yellow shirt stoops to dip a vessel in the water running over the ground, with a white horse and onlookers beside him.
days.look: Look again at the man stooping to the water that runs where the ground was dry. Where might God be opening a way you cannot yet see?
days.license: Artist died 1679; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gelijkenis van de rechter die wordt lastiggevallen door een klagende vrouw, RP-P-OB-46.028.jpg
days.title: The Parable of the Unjust Judge
days.alt: In an engraving, a woman in a long cloak comes forward to the seated judge and his court, with a town behind them.
days.look: Look again at the woman who comes forward before the judge. What are you still bringing to God, even after a long time?
days.license: Artist died 1712; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: BOUCHET - Joseph reconnu par ses freres, 1789.jpg
days.title: Joseph Recognized by His Brothers
days.alt: Joseph, in a blue sleeve and pink robe, folds his young brother in an embrace while the other brothers kneel and reach toward them.
days.look: Look again at Joseph’s arms around his brother and the kneeling brothers beside them. Who is the one you find hardest to forgive?
days.license: Artist died 1842; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Bellini,Giovanni - Agony in the Garden - National Gallery.jpg
days.title: The Agony in the Garden
days.alt: Jesus kneels in prayer on a rocky rise in an evening landscape while three disciples sleep below him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus praying alone while his friends sleep. Can you bring God your tears, even when the answer is not what you asked?
days.license: Artist died 1516; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: (Albi) Saint Jude Thaddée 1620 - Georges de La Tour Inv.166.jpg
days.title: Saint Jude Thaddeus
days.alt: St. Jude, bearded and gazing aside, holds the halberd that marks his martyrdom.
days.look: Look again at Jude’s steady, watchful face. How will you keep yourself in God’s love while you wait?
days.license: Artist died 1652; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
days.alt: Disciples haul a net from a boat on a green lake while a man swims toward shore and Christ stands on the bank in a red robe.
days.look: Look again at the net rising from the water and Christ waiting on the shore. What would it mean to trust that God can give more than you dared to ask?
days.license: Artist died 1446; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
